test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph:

1. This ensures survival of the best-adapted individuals.

2. Life’s diversity has arisen over long periods.

3. Useful traits accumulate gradually.

4. Variation grants some individuals an advantage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the process of evolution and how diversity in life has developed over time.
 
• **Sentence 2 is the first sentence** as it introduces the overarching idea of life’s diversity evolving over time:
 
 
• "Life’s diversity has arisen over long periods."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 follows** by explaining how variation plays a role in evolution:
 
 
• "Variation grants some individuals an advantage."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is next** as it describes how these advantageous traits accumulate:
 
 
• "Useful traits accumulate gradually."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 concludes** by stating the result of this process:
 
 
• "This ensures survival of the best-adapted individuals."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2, 4, 3, 1**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Life’s diversity has arisen over long periods. Variation grants some individuals an advantage. Useful traits accumulate gradually. This ensures survival of the best-adapted individuals."
